title: Mailwoman recognize family definition, version 1
description: A shape-only grammar family defined as data by a package other than recognize-core: regular-expression shapes, their scopes and overlap declarations, and metadata the generated TypeScript carries. recognize-build --definition compiles it into the IR, an artifact and generated TypeScript. A shape that declares captures, a validator or a handler is refused with a diagnostic.

generator.description: The command the generated files name as their generator.

fields.description: The field reader that fills the family's result fields, the TypeScript type of those fields, and the module the generated code imports the type from.

metadata.description: Family-level data copied into the generated TypeScript. The artifact does not carry it.

shape.description: One shape. The pattern holds no assertion, because the scope anchors it, and it can match no empty string.

pattern.description: A regular-expression string. A case-insensitive pattern carries an inline flag such as (?i-u:...), which folds ASCII case only.

scope.description: Where the shape may match. The default is whole.

overlaps.description: The IDs of the shapes this one overlaps by design. One side of a pair declares it.

metadata.description: Data copied into the generated TypeScript beside the shape's ID.
